g.text: Supplier: writes an UNAVAILABLE fact at the hub.
Purchaser: UNAVAILABLE fact at the node; the hub
only sees the attribute in the requirement's list.
The attribute is never asked again.
the attribute stays UNKNOWN (follow-up next round).
A fact on a PROVISIONAL attribute is shown to all
Not a stored hub status: the question stays
DRAFT at the hub until the requirement arrives.
PURCHASER questions always use template attributes.
then node issues a new requirement
